title: Dense Retrieval & Vector Hybrid Embeddings in RAG Architectures

raw_text:
DENSE RETRIEVAL & VECTOR HYBRID EMBEDDINGS IN RAG ARCHITECTURES

Section 1. Abstract & Introduction
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) bridges external knowledge bases with Large Language Models. We evaluate pgvector with HNSW indexing against traditional BM25 keyword search on 50,000 legal contracts.

Section 3. Vector Embeddings & pgvector Cosine Metrics
Vector distance calculations utilize Cosine Distance (1 - cos(theta)) and L2 distance (||u - v||_2). HNSW indexing achieves 98.2% recall with sub-12ms latency under 1536-dimensional OpenAI / Gemini embeddings.

Section 5. Chunking Strategies & Context Poisoning
Fixed-size chunking (500 tokens, 50 token overlap) exhibits a 14% context fragmentation rate on multi-page legal clauses. Dynamic semantic chunking by section boundary improves precision by 31%.
